resources.string: Adds a row with the ID and data center to user, group and channel profiles. Tap it to copy the ID.
Your number won\'t show in Settings, on the account screen and in your profile. Handy when you share your screen.
Chats always stay. With the settings tab hidden, open Settings from the three-dot menu on the chats screen. Tabs change after a restart.
Telegram\'s own setting. Turn off the in-app browser there to open links in your browser app.

Runs a small proxy right on your phone and carries Telegram traffic over WebSocket, the same way the web version connects. No server or VPN needed, works without any setup.

Photos and videos may load slower, calls may not work through it. Based on tg-ws-proxy by Flowseal and its Rust port by valnesfjord (MIT).

Shared Cloudflare domains help when your provider blocks Telegram's own servers, they are run by the tg-ws-proxy community. Your own Cloudflare domain or Worker keeps it in your hands. Several domains go comma-separated. Not sure? Leave the fields empty.
dumgram is an unofficial fork, so Premium and Stars can\'t be bought here. Use the official Telegram app for purchases, they will show up here too.
